children: AtkinsRealis Group's nuclear opportunity is bigger than the market currently appreciates, says TD Cowen analyst Michael Tupholme. He says that the company's proprietary Candu nuclear reactor opportunity is quite large, especially for new builds. Tupholme points to Ontario, where in the province alone new builds alone represent a revenue opportunity of around C$38 billion compared with its current nuclear segment backlog of C$4.2 billion. The analyst says that a catalyst to look out for will be a favorable Ontario nuclear-technology selection decision, expected in 2H. "We expect strong Nuclear results over our forecast horizon (even before considering new build upside), while we see a favourable nuclear tech. decision for Ontario new builds as a re-rating catalyst," Tupholme says. (adriano.marchese@wsj.com)
